channel.title: Logos Ecosystem Development
channel.description: Last 10 notes on Logos Ecosystem Development

item.title: Circle Content Management System
item.description: Enable circles to collaboratively manage knowledge, documentation, and content while maintaining privacy and censorship resistance.

item.title: Multisig Treasury / Vault
item.description: Enables secure shared custody of shielded assets requiring multiple signatures to authorise transactions, protecting treasuries and shared funds without revealing signers or balances.

item.title: Private NFT Ownership
item.description: Enables NFTs whose owner and metadata are encrypted, allowing for private digital asset ownership, anonymous credentials, and confidential collectibles.

item.title: Package Manager
item.description: Decentralized package manager for discovering, resolving, and retrieving Logos modules.

item.title: Logos Core DevEx
item.description: Logos Core Developer Experience Overview of the different development paths for building applications on the Logos technology stack.

item.title: Activity Hub
item.description: The activity hub serves two main purposes, which are related to the life cycle of Logos movement participants (better word?).

item.title: Logos JS SDK
item.description: JavaScript/TypeScript SDK for building web applications that run within the Logos App, with full access to Logos Core modules (blockchain, storage, messaging).

item.title: Logos JS SDK (Browser)
item.description: An extension of the logos_js_sdk to enable web app built with it run in standard browsers, with limited access to Logos functionality.

item.title: Logos Wallet
item.description: Privacy-preserving wallet infrastructure for managing Logos blockchain accounts, signing shielded transactions, and interacting with the Logos ecosystem.

item.title: liblogos
item.description: C++ SDK library providing the core API for developing Logos modules, enabling inter-module communication and access to platform services.
